decision.rationale: The pin work after the move to D-194 is correct: that commit appended fifty-one lines to COORD and left file 08 untouched, and the subject pins the new COORD digest and the unchanged file 08 digest, with all thirty-five digests recomputing and recordedInputs.HEAD equal to live HEAD. Two features unique to this lineage were traced rather than assumed. First, the subject cites its catalog at v2 where every sibling cites v1: catalog v1 was REJECT 0/1 and v2 landed that finding at ACCEPT 0/0 with the class list unchanged, so citing v2 is the correct choice and all three g20 joins have done so consistently. Other substance was re-derived: sdk v5's ledger matches the two named obligations exactly, the single class matches harness and catalog byte-for-byte, and the harness's leftoverNameNote, closedIf and exactByteIntent keys were each found as claimed. No version collision exists at v3, all three version disclaimers are true, and eight cited reviews are all ACCEPT 0/0. Three candidate defects were examined and all three failed the test that a finding must be false in these bytes rather than merely unusual, so none is charged. At 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX the decision rule yields ACCEPT.
